correctness.rationale: Define F_n on F2^n modulo the all-ones vector for n≥2, adjacency Hamming distance 1 or n−1; cardinality 2^{n−1}. For t selected quotient vertices, normalize the first and record counts of the 2^{t−1} coordinate-bit patterns. All one-vertex extensions split every count independently, so the nested Hintikka-type recursion is exhaustive. Atomic types of four vertices need only tell each mismatch count 0,1,n−1,n. The constructive 2h→h splitting lemma proves all n,m≥16 four-round equivalent, not from finite sampling. Independent Python recreation through n=16 returned representatives 2,3,4,5,6,7,8,8,10,...,10. A rank-four diameter-at-most-4 sentence separates F_8 and F_9 from F_10 (their graph diameter floor(n/2)). Thus eight classes, sharp family-relative maximum F_10 of 512 vertices. Direct small-n checking is a separate finite corroboration, not the infinite argument.
